sourceEvidence.excerpt:
an unsigned visitor could open
`#big-picture-data-centre-deal-2026-08-24` directly. The reader showed:

- section label: `THE BIG PICTURE`;
- exact title: *Why data centres became a public villain—and what a better
  bargain would look like*;
- visible deck: `Data centres are not new. What changed was AI: bigger
  facilities, lower trust and a flood of alarming claims that are hard to
  compare.`;
- published date: `August 24, 2026`; and
- article line: `PUBLISHED AUGUST 24, 2026 · UPDATED AND CHECKED AUGUST 29,
  2026`.

The custom-origin navigation retained visible `Sign in` and `Join the town`
links, but opening the article did not display a login prompt. This confirms the
observed anonymous reader journey only; it does not establish account, storage,
or accessibility behaviour.

## Failures

No broken destination, missing listed book title/opening, missing data-centres
article, or failed Catch Me Up/archive selection was observed. The only
uncompleted requested observation is a fresh Mme CLAi-O draw and its move text,
intentionally not performed because it would mutate device-local history.
